summary_context: Built complete index enrichment system and pre-read oracle for the AI agent harness. Key deliverables: (1) Rewrote scripts/symbol_indexer.py to compute line_end (brace-depth tracking), read_hint (offset/limit precomputed), and keywords (camelCase split + path tokens) — enriching knowledge/index_variables.json with 68 symbols. Fixed nested {'files':{}} structure bug so key_sections and keywords now correctly populate knowledge/index_files.json entries. (2) Created scripts/lookup.py — T0 pre-read oracle that searches symbols + files + sessions in one call, returning file+line+read_hint before any Read call; supports --session and --json flags; wired as Tier 0 before T1-T3 grep tiers in editor/SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md §R5. (3) Created scripts/session_indexer.py + knowledge/index_sessions.json — indexes all 83 sessions with keywords, summary excerpt, tasks, status, date. (4) Wired session lookup into 4 skills: editor §R9 Step 0 (prior fix history), session_manager §2 resume (prior context), self_improve §2 Step 4.5 (CFP trigger context), coder before scaffold (prior feature check). (5) Updated skill-manifest.json with lookup_oracle blocks for editor and coder; added index_sessions.json to never_at_boot list and on_demand_files for editor/session_manager. (6) session_manager §3 Step 5 now runs session_indexer.py on every close to keep index fresh.
